user.title: Connect to TeddyCloud
user.description: Enter the connection details for your teddyCloud server.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of your teddyCloud server, e.g. 192.168.1.10
data_description.port: The teddyCloud HTTP API port — usually 7780, NOT the HTTPS web UI or Toniebox cloud-emulation port
data_description.ssl: Enable only if teddyCloud's API is served over HTTPS on the port above
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable only if teddyCloud uses a self-signed certificate
data_description.sidecar_url: Base URL of a teddycloud-nfc-bridge instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000. Leave empty to skip the assign_nfc_tag service.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure TeddyCloud
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for your teddyCloud server.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to teddyCloud at that host/port
error.ssl_error: SSL certificate validation failed — disable 'Verify SSL certificate' if teddyCloud uses a self-signed certificate

abort.already_configured: This teddyCloud server is already configured

assign_nfc_tag.name: Assign NFC tag
assign_nfc_tag.description: Uploads a Tonie .nfc dump to the configured nfc-bridge sidecar, which caches the content on teddyCloud and triggers the download.

file.name: NFC file
file.description: The .nfc dump (Flipper Zero format) of the Tonie figure to assign to this box.
